create.name: Padma Yoga Sisak
create.bio:
Padma Yoga is a small Ashtanga school in Sisak, Croatia. It teaches only Ashtanga in the tradition of K. Pattabhi Jois and R. Sharath Jois, under the guidance of Ružica Matagić, who first met the method through David Swenson in 2008, trained with several teachers in Europe and the United States, and received Level 2 authorisation from Sharath Jois at the end of 2019. Angelina Tkalčić, also authorised, teaches alongside her, and the team travels to Mysore each year to continue its own study.

Mornings and evenings are given to Mysore-style practice, in which beginners and experienced students work through the sequence at their own pace with individual help, and led classes run twice a week. A gentler slow-flow class and yoga nidra sessions round out the week. The school says its aim is to prepare students who may one day travel to Mysore themselves. In October 2024 it opened a new practice hall in the Viktorovac neighbourhood, and its site carries plain-language guides in Croatian to pranayama and to starting out in Ashtanga.

courses.title: Članarine (class passes)
courses.description: Monthly passes and single classes for the timetable of Mysore-style and led Ashtanga, slow flow and yoga nidra, with private sessions on request. The price list is dated October 2026.
courses.price: NEOGRANIČENO 45,00 €; 8 TERMINA 40,00 €; 4 TERMINA 35,00 €; POJEDINAČNI SAT 15,00 €; PRIVATNI SAT (75min) 60,00 €

courses.title: Ashtanga Mysore
courses.description: The school's main class: self-paced practice of the Ashtanga sequence in a group, with the teacher giving each student breath and technique guidance and adding new postures as earlier ones settle. Complete beginners start here with sun salutations.

free_resources.title: Pranayama – vodič za početnike
free_resources.description: A free beginner's guide in Croatian to pranayama: what the word means, the three phases of the breath (puraka, rechaka and kumbhaka) and how to start a simple breathing practice.

free_resources.title: Upute za početnike
free_resources.description: Practical first-steps advice for newcomers to Ashtanga at the school: which classes suit complete beginners, what to bring, and how Mysore sessions work without booking.
